dialogues.jp: 「……ことり、遅いな」
dialogues.en: "...She's late."
dialogues.text: "...She's late."

dialogues.jp:
「お手玉遊びにも飽きた……って、そもそも、
　食べ物で遊んじゃいけない……」
dialogues.en:
"I tired of playing with these bags... they're not toys
anyway..."
dialogues.text:
"I tired of playing with these bags... they're not toys
anyway..."

dialogues.jp:
「紅茶も……まあ、そろそろ、冷たい飲み物で
　もいいかもな……」
dialogues.en:
"The black tea as well... I should've bought a cold
drink..."
dialogues.text:
"The black tea as well... I should've bought a cold
drink..."

dialogues.jp:
春の陽光に手をかざしながら、そんなどうでも
いいことを呟く。
dialogues.en:
I shielded my eyes from the glaring spring sun, as I
muttered little nothings to myself.
dialogues.text:
I shielded my eyes from the glaring spring sun, as I
muttered little nothings to myself.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉君……」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-kun..."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-kun..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あ、ことり……」
dialogues.en: "Ah, Kotori..."
dialogues.text: "Ah, Kotori..."

dialogues.jp: 待っていたはずなのに。
dialogues.en: I've been waiting for this.
dialogues.text: I've been waiting for this.

dialogues.jp:
そこから先、ことりにかける言葉が見つからな
かった。
dialogues.en: I wanted to talk earlier, but I couldn't find her.
dialogues.text: I wanted to talk earlier, but I couldn't find her.

dialogues.jp:
もしかしてまた、不用意な俺の言葉がことりを
深く傷つけるかも知れない。
dialogues.en: I had to be careful, or I might hurt her even more...
dialogues.text: I had to be careful, or I might hurt her even more...

dialogues.jp: そう思うと、言葉が出てこなかった。
dialogues.en: Thinking that, the words couldn't come out.
dialogues.text: Thinking that, the words couldn't come out.

dialogues.jp: だけど──。
dialogues.en: But--
dialogues.text: But--

dialogues.jp:
俺の何がことりを傷つけたのか。知らなければ、
同じ過ちを繰り返してしまうかも知れないから。
dialogues.en:
I wanted to know what I did to hurt her. If I knew, I'd
remember never to make the same mistake again.
dialogues.text:
I wanted to know what I did to hurt her. If I knew, I'd
remember never to make the same mistake again.

dialogues.jp: もう二度と、ことりを傷つけたくはないから。
dialogues.en: Never to hurt her so badly again.
dialogues.text: Never to hurt her so badly again.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、ことりをジッと見つめて。
dialogues.en: I fixed my gaze on Kotori.
dialogues.text: I fixed my gaze on Kotori.

dialogues.jp: 「俺のせいだよな」
dialogues.en: "It's my fault."
dialogues.text: "It's my fault."

dialogues.jp: 単刀直入に言った。
dialogues.en: I said it point-blank.
dialogues.text: I said it point-blank.

dialogues.jp:
単刀直入すぎた。ことりが困惑気味の視線を送っ
てくる。
dialogues.en:
A direct hit. Kotori looked up at me with a sense of
bewilderment.
dialogues.text:
A direct hit. Kotori looked up at me with a sense of
bewilderment.

dialogues.jp: 「まずはゴメン！」
dialogues.en: "First of all, I'm really sorry!"
dialogues.text: "First of all, I'm really sorry!"

dialogues.jp: 思いっきり頭を下げる。
dialogues.en: I bowed my head deeply.
dialogues.text: I bowed my head deeply.

dialogues.jp:
「ことりの調子が最近悪いのは、俺が不用意な
　こと言っちまって、傷つけたせいだろ？」
dialogues.en:
"You've been feeling so bad lately because of something I
said, wasn't it?"
dialogues.text:
"You've been feeling so bad lately because of something I
said, wasn't it?"

dialogues.jp:
「俺、何言ったかな？　教えてくれ。……同じ
　ことして、もうことりを傷つけたくないんだ
　よ」
dialogues.en:
"What was it that I said? Please tell me... I'd never say it
again."
dialogues.text:
"What was it that I said? Please tell me... I'd never say it
again."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "...Asakura-kun..."
dialogues.text: "...Asakura-kun..."

dialogues.jp:
ことりが肩に手を触れてきた。触れる瞬間、こ
とりの手が震える。まるで初めて触れるかのよ
うに……。
dialogues.en:
I held on to Kotori's shoulders. At my touch, her shoulders
started trembling. As if that was the first time I touched
them...
dialogues.text:
I held on to Kotori's shoulders. At my touch, her shoulders
started trembling. As if that was the first time I touched
them...

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「……違いますから。これは朝倉君のせいじゃ、
　ないですから……」
dialogues.en: "...It's not that, it's not your fault..."
dialogues.text: "...It's not that, it's not your fault..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「だけど……っ」

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「本当に調子が悪いんです。今もだるくて……
　早退しようと思ってて」
dialogues.en:
"I just feel a little sick, that's all. I figured I'd leave
early today..."
dialogues.text:
"I just feel a little sick, that's all. I figured I'd leave
early today..."

dialogues.jp: 手に持っていた通学用の鞄を見せる。
dialogues.en:
I looked more closely, and saw her carrying her schoolbag on
her arm.
dialogues.text:
I looked more closely, and saw her carrying her schoolbag on
her arm.

dialogues.jp: 「そ、そっか……」
dialogues.en: "I, I see..."
dialogues.text: "I, I see..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……あ、じゃあ、昼食は？」
dialogues.en: "...Ah, what about lunch?"
dialogues.text: "...Ah, what about lunch?"

dialogues.jp:
この時間に早退するということは、昼食を食べ
ないで帰るということになる。
dialogues.en:
If she's leaving now, does that mean she's going home
without eating lunch?
dialogues.text:
If she's leaving now, does that mean she's going home
without eating lunch?

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「食欲、ありませんから……」
dialogues.en: "I'm not hungry..."
dialogues.text: "I'm not hungry..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「それじゃ、朝倉君、バイバイ……」
dialogues.en: "I'd see you later, Asakura-kun, bye bye..."
dialogues.text: "I'd see you later, Asakura-kun, bye bye..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「あ、ま、待った。食欲なくても、お菓子くら
　いなら食べられるだろ？」
dialogues.en:
"Ah, w, wait. Even if you're not hungry, why don't you take
a pastry with you in case your appetite returns?"
dialogues.text:
"Ah, w, wait. Even if you're not hungry, why don't you take
a pastry with you in case your appetite returns?"

dialogues.jp:
お菓子を食べたからといって、すぐに元気にな
れるわけじゃないが。
dialogues.en:
It was a desperate attempt, but maybe if she ate something
sweet, she'd cheer up a bit.
dialogues.text:
It was a desperate attempt, but maybe if she ate something
sweet, she'd cheer up a bit.

dialogues.jp:
それでも、少しでもことりに元気になって欲し
かったから、俺は和菓子を出すことにした。
dialogues.en:
Hoping against hope, I started the process to create a
wagashi.
dialogues.text:
Hoping against hope, I started the process to create a
wagashi.

dialogues.jp:
手を背中に持っていき、まんじゅうをイメージ
する。
dialogues.en:
I placed my hand behind my back, and started thinking of a
manjuu.
dialogues.text:
I placed my hand behind my back, and started thinking of a
manjuu.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「なにか和菓子を……出してくれるんですか？」
dialogues.en: "The wagashi... isn't coming out."
dialogues.text: "The wagashi... isn't coming out."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あ、ああ、そう──」
dialogues.en: "A, ahh, looks like--"
dialogues.text: "A, ahh, looks like--"

dialogues.jp: 絶句。
dialogues.en: Silence.
dialogues.text: Silence.

dialogues.jp: ｛・・・・・・・・／どうしてことりが｝、｛・・・・・・・・／それを知っている｝？
dialogues.en: Why. Does. She. Know. That?
dialogues.text: Why. Does. She. Know. That?

dialogues.jp:
それを知っている人間は、かなり限られている。
ともかく、ことりは知らないはずだった。
dialogues.en:
There's 2 people who know that I can do that, and they're
not particularly close to her... she shouldn't have known
that.
dialogues.text:
There's 2 people who know that I can do that, and they're
not particularly close to her... she shouldn't have known
that.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「それじゃ」
dialogues.en: "I'd see you later..."
dialogues.text: "I'd see you later..."

dialogues.jp: 固いベンチの上で、｛いず／居住｝まいを正す。
dialogues.en: I collapsed back down onto the banch.
dialogues.text: I collapsed back down onto the banch.

dialogues.jp:
どうしてことりが、和菓子の能力を知っていた
のだろう？
dialogues.en: How did she know about my wagashi power?
dialogues.text: How did she know about my wagashi power?

dialogues.jp: そして──、
dialogues.en: And--
dialogues.text: And--

dialogues.jp: ことりは、どうしてしまったんだろう？
dialogues.en: What is wrong with her in the first place?
dialogues.text: What is wrong with her in the first place?

dialogues.jp:
今のことりは、まるで｛さえず／囀｝ることを忘れてしまっ
た小鳥のようで……。
dialogues.en:
The Kotori now is like a small bird who's forgotten how to
chirp...
dialogues.text:
The Kotori now is like a small bird who's forgotten how to
chirp...

dialogues.jp:
大切ななにかを失ってしまったかのような喪失
感が胸をさらう。
dialogues.en: Like the feeling of having lost something very important.
dialogues.text: Like the feeling of having lost something very important.

dialogues.jp:
手が、パンを｛もてあそ／弄｝んでいた。食欲を失っている自
分を見つけた。
dialogues.en:
I absentmindedly played with the bread I was holding. I'd
lost my own appetite now.
dialogues.text:
I absentmindedly played with the bread I was holding. I'd
lost my own appetite now.

dialogues.jp: ◆能力の消失◆
dialogues.en: ◆Loss of Power◆
dialogues.text: ◆Loss of Power◆

dialogues.jp: 昼休み、またことりが遅刻をした。
dialogues.en: Kotori was late again for lunch.
dialogues.text: Kotori was late again for lunch.

dialogues.jp:
最近ことりの調子が悪いのは、俺が傷つけてし
まったからで。
dialogues.en:
I thought that her recently poor mood was due to something I
said that hurt her.
dialogues.text:
I thought that her recently poor mood was due to something I
said that hurt her.

dialogues.jp:
俺が思いっきり謝ると、ことりは俺のせいじゃ
ないという。
dialogues.en: I tried to apologize, but she said that it wasn't my fault.
dialogues.text: I tried to apologize, but she said that it wasn't my fault.

dialogues.jp: 本当に調子が悪いだけだと……。
dialogues.en: She was just feeling a bit unwell...
dialogues.text: She was just feeling a bit unwell...

dialogues.jp:
和菓子でも食べて少しでも元気になってもらお
うと思って、俺は和菓子を出そうとした。
dialogues.en:
Hoping to cheer her up a little with a sweet, I started
trying to make a wagashi come out.
dialogues.text:
Hoping to cheer her up a little with a sweet, I started
trying to make a wagashi come out.

dialogues.jp: が、手の平から、和菓子が出てこない。
dialogues.en: But the wagashi would not appear in my palm.
dialogues.text: But the wagashi would not appear in my palm.

dialogues.jp:
さらに不思議な事に、ことりがその能力を知っ
ていた。
dialogues.en:
Along with the mystery, apparently Kotori knew about it as
well.
dialogues.text:
Along with the mystery, apparently Kotori knew about it as
well.

dialogues.jp: 一体、どういう事なんだろうな？
dialogues.en: Just what on earth is happening?
dialogues.text: Just what on earth is happening?
